base: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one standalone landscape 3:2 illustrated how-to card for FROG Creek Dominion, premium cohesive painterly 3D concept art. Frogs have natural frog anatomy: low wide four-legged bodies, rounded snouts, large expressive eyes and long hind legs, NOT humanoid people. Green is player/allies, yellow-gold is neutral, rust brown/purple are enemies. Miniature moss-stone castles, broad wetland islands, water lilies and reeds. Soft cinematic daylight, rich fern green and warm ochre, tactile skin/stone, strong legible silhouettes at small card size.

scenes.movement: One bare green frog walking forward across a mossy bank, a faint trail of three small footprints behind it, wide creek and frog-scale castle in distance. Show normal ground movement.
scenes.sprint: A bare green frog sprinting low across a bank toward its waiting green companions, powerful extended hind legs and lively grass motion, a short motion trail. Show fast running.
scenes.jump: A bare green frog in midair over a narrow water gap between two mossy rocks, curved water droplets tracing its leap and a clear safe landing rock.
scenes.block: A green frog bracing low with its forelegs in front of its face, deflecting a hostile brown frog's tongue strike; small protective arc of light at contact, no physical shield item, no equipment.
scenes.kick: A green frog delivering a flying hind-leg kick into a hostile brown frog, midair action above a mossy bank, small bright contact flash, no blood.
scenes.slam: A green frog landing heavily on a mossy bank with a circular dust-and-water shockwave, two hostile brown frogs pushed outward, clearly show landing ground impact.
scenes.sweep: A green frog sweeping its long elastic pink tongue in a broad sideways arc toward two nearby hostile brown frogs, short grass bank, clear curved action shape.
scenes.dodge: A green frog springing sideways out of the path of a heron's downward beak strike, droplets and subtle translucent previous-position trail, clearly show evasive side movement.
scenes.intimidate: A dominant bare green frog swelling its throat and croaking, expanding soft golden sound rings, three smaller hostile brown frogs backing away, one lowering its head in surrender. No crown.
scenes.interact: A bare green frog close to a little pile of reeds and fallen sticks at a creek bank, reaching toward one stick with a front paw, clear collect interaction with physical natural materials.
scenes.recruit: A green noble frog offering a small leaf bowl containing flies to a neutral yellow-gold frog outside a safe moss-stone castle, the neutral frog looks thoughtful, friendly reciprocal exchange, no crown.
scenes.forage: A small squad of three green frogs gathering real flies around a busy swarm over wetland plants, one catches a fly with its pink tongue, another returns toward a small food store.
scenes.groups: Three distinct small formations of green frogs on an island viewed from a raised angle; each group has a different colored natural leaf marker blue green ochre, with a commanding noble frog in foreground, organized squads.
scenes.flank: A small group of green frogs approaches a brown enemy group from the side through reeds while a second green squad engages from the front, elevated tactical view with one subtle curved trail showing the side approach.
scenes.guard: Two green frog sentries guarding the closed gate of a compact moss-stone castle with corner towers, another sentry on a tower, a distant hostile brown frog approaching outside.
scenes.regroup: Several scattered green frogs turning and hopping back toward their green leader on a safe bank, converging subtle dust trails, clearly reuniting the squad.
scenes.build: A defended frog-scale castle under construction, timber scaffolds, unfinished moss-stone walls, stacked reeds and stones; two green frogs work while one watches approaching distant enemies. No finished magical building.
scenes.store: A frog-scale food store inside a castle courtyard, leaf roof, neatly stored bundles of reeds and sealed woven fly baskets, green frog placing food into storage, visibly useful supply building.
scenes.nursery: A frog recruitment lodge inside a moss-stone castle, warm leaf canopy, new bare green frog coming out to meet a small waiting squad, food baskets visibly supplied, no babies or magical spawning.
scenes.training: A training ground inside a moss-stone courtyard, two bare green frogs practicing kicks and tongue strikes against soft reed dummies, an experienced frog overseeing. No armor appearing.
scenes.watchtower: A moss-stone castle corner watchtower with a green frog lookout spotting a distant approaching brown squad across the creek, a small natural warning bell and clear sight line.
scenes.walls: Strong continuous moss-stone castle walls and four corner towers surrounding a protected courtyard, closed reinforced wooden gate facing brown frog attackers; emphasize complete enclosure and sturdy gate.
scenes.upgrade: A moss-stone frog castle visibly being expanded by physical construction, stronger corner tower and thicker completed wall on one side with scaffolding on the other, material stacks and working green frogs.
scenes.repair: Two green frogs physically repairing a cracked moss-stone castle gate and wall using reeds, timber braces and fresh stone blocks; damaged section clearly becoming sound, no magic healing effect.
scenes.specialization: Three frog-scale castle courtyards along one scenic wetland ridge: one with strong watchtower defenses, one with food and material stores, one with a training yard and crafting bench. Three distinct purposeful bases, cohesive scene.
scenes.craft: Green frogs at a low stone workbench weaving a real reed armor vest with a shell plate, loose reeds and shells next to the unfinished item, one completed wearable leaf-and-reed vest on the bench, no magical sparkle.
scenes.food: A frog-scale woven storage basket containing edible flies in a leaf-lined enclosure, several small leaf bowls for army rations, green frog carrying one ration toward its squad near a castle.
scenes.flies: Close view of a real small swarm of flies hovering over lush wetland flowers and reeds, a small green frog catches one with a pink tongue, clear distinction between living swarm and stored food.
scenes.materials: A clear attractive collection of practical building materials on a wetland bank: bundles of cut reeds, fallen timber sticks, broad leaves and mossy small stones; a green frog gathering a reed bundle.
scenes.pearls: A few luminous natural pearls nestled in an open freshwater shell on a shallow creek bank, a large predatory fish's silhouette in deeper water nearby; rare guarded crafting resource, no human jewelry.
scenes.neutral: A friendly cautious yellow-gold frog sitting on a lily-covered bank, leaf bundle beside it, a bare green player frog approaching slowly at respectful distance; no hostile pose, clear yellow-vs-green distinction.
scenes.enemies: A brown and muted purple rival frog squad guarding its own moss-stone castle with rust-colored leaf banners, alert purposeful defenders and one larger commander, no green allies in their formation.
scenes.surrender: A defeated but living brown frog crouched calmly with lowered head and forelegs raised slightly, a small pale leaf laid down beside it, green victor at respectful distance; readable peaceful surrender, no gore.
scenes.heron: A towering gray heron on a creek bank telegraphing a beak strike by lowering its head and focusing on a small green frog, clear danger zone and open side escape space, natural proportions.
scenes.snake: A long olive water snake coiled low among wet reeds preparing a forward lunge at a small green frog, head drawn back before striking, clear side escape route.
scenes.fish: A large dark freshwater predator fish rising near the surface with open mouth and splashing water beside a lily pad carrying a small green frog; deep water threat, a safe stone bank nearby.
scenes.bosses: An immense scarred heron towering above a frog-scale castle and a disciplined green frog army, epic but readable size comparison, cloudy wetlands, no crown worn by bird, no magical creatures.
scenes.map: Elevated panoramic wetland geography with several moss-stone frog castles on large islands, connecting shallow paths and wide creek channels, a small frog looking over the landscape in foreground. NO labels or UI.
scenes.frontier: A green frog leader and a small travelling squad reaching a ridge overlooking a fresh wide wetland valley with distant rival castles and unexplored river channels, a familiar safe castle behind them, sense of continuing expansion.
scenes.progress: Three green frogs of the same recognizable species standing together at increasing natural body maturity and confident posture, all bare and WITHOUT armor or crown; beside them a separate workbench displays crafted reed and shell equipment. Show experience changes body but gear is physically crafted.
scenes.respawn: A tired green noble frog recovering at a safe leaf-roof shelter beside its own castle at dawn, two surviving allies nearby and distant smoke beyond the creek conveying that a battle was lost elsewhere; hope and persistent world, no magical reversal.
